months.title: Foundation
months.goal: Learn and groove the technique on the six main lifts, get your body used to 30 min of cardio plus lifting, and start your log. Loads are deliberately light: leave 2-4 reps in the tank on every set.
months.technique: None yet. Own the technique: lower every rep over 2-3 s.
months.nutrition: Lean gain: TDEE + 200-300 kcal, protein 1.6-2.2 g/kg. Starting with higher body fat? Eat at maintenance (recomposition).
months.base: Months 1-3 go by effort, not percentages. Pick a weight that leaves the target RIR (reps in reserve). The % column is a rough guide only.

months.title: Hypertrophy I
months.goal: Start the real muscle-building work: more sets on the main lifts and sets taken closer to failure. Week 4 is the first deload.
months.technique: None. Use double progression: add reps each week, then add weight.
months.nutrition: Lean gain: TDEE + 200-300 kcal, protein 1.6-2.2 g/kg. Starting with higher body fat? Eat at maintenance (recomposition).
months.base: Months 1-3 go by effort, not percentages. Pick a weight that leaves the target RIR (reps in reserve). The % column is a rough guide only.

months.title: Hypertrophy II
months.goal: Heavier hypertrophy work: 6-8 reps on the main lifts and drop sets on isolation work. At the end of the month you estimate your 1RMs, which set your Month 4 percentages.
months.technique: Drop set on the LAST set of every isolation exercise: hit the target reps, drop the weight about 25%, then rep out to RIR 0-1.
months.nutrition: Lean gain: TDEE + 200-300 kcal, protein 1.6-2.2 g/kg. Starting with higher body fat? Eat at maintenance (recomposition).
months.base: Months 1-3 go by effort, not percentages. Pick a weight that leaves the target RIR (reps in reserve). The % column is a rough guide only. After Week 4, calculate your e1RM for every main lift with the RIR-adjusted Epley formula in the README.

months.title: Strength I: Accumulation
months.goal: Switch to strength. The main lifts move to 5×5 with percentage-based loading. Accessories stay at 8-12 reps so you keep building muscle.
months.technique: None. Strength months: save your energy for the main lifts.
months.nutrition: Lean gain: TDEE + 200-300 kcal, protein 1.6-2.2 g/kg. Starting with higher body fat? Eat at maintenance (recomposition).
months.base: Percentages are of the e1RM you calculated from Month 3, Week 4.

months.title: Strength II: Intensification
months.goal: Heavier weights, fewer reps (3-4). This is where the big strength gains come from. Week 4 is a deload.
months.nutrition: Lean gain: TDEE + 200-300 kcal, protein 1.6-2.2 g/kg. Starting with higher body fat? Eat at maintenance (recomposition).
months.base: Percentages are of your Month 3 e1RM. If Month 4 felt easy, add 2.5% to the e1RM (autoregulation rule, README).

months.title: Strength III: Realization & Test
months.goal: Practise heavy triples, doubles and singles, then test your new maxes in Week 4. The tested numbers set your percentages for the whole of Q3.
months.nutrition: Lean gain: TDEE + 200-300 kcal, protein 1.6-2.2 g/kg. Starting with higher body fat? Eat at maintenance (recomposition).
months.base: Percentages are of your current e1RM (Month 3 e1RM, plus any autoregulation bumps).

months.title: Hypertrophy III: Volume
months.goal: Use your new strength to build muscle: higher volume and slow eccentrics. The accessory list shifts toward V-taper aesthetics (upper chest, side delts, lats, arms).
months.technique: 3 s lowering on every accessory rep. On the last set of isolation work, finish with lengthened partials (half reps in the stretched position) until RIR 0.
months.nutrition: Lean gain: TDEE + 200-300 kcal, protein 1.6-2.2 g/kg. Starting with higher body fat? Eat at maintenance (recomposition).
months.base: Percentages are of the 1RM you tested in Week 25.

months.title: Aesthetic Specialization (V-Taper)
months.goal: Specialization month for the V-taper look: extra sets for side delts, upper chest and lats, plus intensity techniques. The main lifts drop to 3×6, which is enough to keep your strength.
months.technique: ★ = specialization exercise and gets +1 set (already included below). Rest-pause on the last set of compound accessories (rest 15 s, rep out again, twice). Myo-reps on the last set of isolation work (one set to RIR 1, then 3-4 mini-sets of 3-5 reps with 15 s rest).
months.nutrition: Lean gain: TDEE + 200-300 kcal, protein 1.6-2.2 g/kg. Starting with higher body fat? Eat at maintenance (recomposition).
months.base: Percentages are of the 1RM you tested in Week 25.

months.title: Powerbuilding
months.goal: Strength and size together: one heavy top set followed by volume back-off sets. This bridges the aesthetics block into the strength peak.
months.technique: Drop set on the last set of every isolation exercise.
months.nutrition: Lean gain: TDEE + 200-300 kcal, protein 1.6-2.2 g/kg. Starting with higher body fat? Eat at maintenance (recomposition).
months.base: Percentages are of the Week 25 1RM. If the top set feels RPE 7 or easier, add 2.5% next week.

months.title: Strength Peak & Test
months.goal: Peak your strength: low reps at high intensity, with accessory volume cut back so you're fresh. Week 4 is test week, aim for PRs on all six lifts.
months.technique: None. Accessory volume is cut back on purpose so you peak.
months.nutrition: Maintenance calories (TDEE), protein 1.6-2.2 g/kg. Fuel the heavy lifting.
months.base: Percentages are of the higher of: your Week 25 test, or the e1RM from your Month 9, Week 4 top set.

months.title: Definition I: Lean Out
months.goal: Reveal the work. Calorie deficit, supersets and shorter rests, and interval cardio on Day C. Heavy 3×5 main lifts keep your strength while you diet.
months.technique: Antagonist supersets and tri-sets with short rest (30-45 s isolation, 60 s compounds). Keep the heavy main work exactly as written.
months.nutrition: Definition: TDEE − 300-500 kcal, protein 2.0-2.4 g/kg, lose 0.5-1% of body weight per week. 8-10k steps/day.
months.base: Percentages are of the 1RM you tested in Week 43.

months.title: Definition II: Final Assessment
months.goal: Final push for definition, then the Week 4 final assessment: strength, photos and measurements. Compare everything with Month 1.
months.technique: Giant-set finish: drop set on the last set of every isolation exercise, short rests.
months.nutrition: Definition: TDEE − 300-500 kcal, protein 2.0-2.4 g/kg, lose 0.5-1% of body weight per week. 8-10k steps/day.
months.base: Percentages are of the 1RM you tested in Week 43.

e1.name: Barbell Bench Press
e1.cue: Shoulder blades squeezed and down, feet planted, bar to mid-chest, press up and slightly back.

e2.name: Leg Press
e2.cue: Feet shoulder-width, mid-platform. Lower until your hips are about to lift off the pad. Never lock the knees.

e3.name: Incline Dumbbell Press (30°)
e3.cue: Upper-chest builder. Elbows at about 45°, deep stretch at the bottom.

e4.name: Lat Pulldown (wide grip)
e4.cue: Chest up, drive the elbows down to your ribs, control the way up.

e5.name: Leg Extension
e5.cue: 1 s squeeze at the top, 3 s on the way down.

e6.name: Standing Calf Raise
e6.cue: 2 s pause in the full stretch at the bottom.

e7.name: Cable Lateral Raise
e7.cue: Lead with the elbow, stop at shoulder height, no swinging.

e8.name: Rope Triceps Pushdown
e8.cue: Elbows pinned to your sides, spread the rope at the bottom.

e9.name: Hanging Knee Raise
e9.cue: No swinging. Curl the pelvis up at the top (posterior tilt).

e10.name: Cable Crunch
e10.cue: Round the spine and bring the ribs to the pelvis. Hips stay still.

e11.name: Barbell Hip Thrust
e11.cue: Upper back on the bench, chin tucked, ribs down. Shins vertical at lockout, 1 s squeeze at the top.

e12.name: Barbell Row
e12.cue: Unrack from safeties at knee height so you never pull the bar off the floor. Torso 30-45°, brace, pull to the lower ribs.

e13.name: Dumbbell Walking Lunge
e13.cue: Long stride, slight forward lean, back knee lightly touches the floor.

e14.name: Single-Arm Dumbbell Row
e14.cue: Hand on the bench, pull the elbow toward your hip, full stretch at the bottom.

e15.name: Lying Leg Curl
e15.cue: Press your hips into the pad, 3 s on the way down.

e16.name: Face Pull
e16.cue: Pull to your forehead, thumbs back, squeeze the rear delts.

e17.name: Incline Dumbbell Curl
e17.cue: Arms hang behind the body for a big stretch. No swinging.

e18.name: Kneeling Ab Wheel Rollout
e18.cue: Ribs down, glutes tight. Roll out only as far as your lower back stays flat.

e19.name: Pallof Press
e19.cue: Stand side-on to the cable, press out and hold 2 s. Don't let it twist you.

e20.name: Standing Overhead Press
e20.cue: Squeeze glutes and abs, bar travels straight up, push your head through at lockout.

e21.name: Pull-up (add weight once 3×10 is easy)
e21.cue: Dead hang to chin over the bar. Can't hit the reps? Use the assisted machine or a band.

e22.name: Dips (assisted if needed)
e22.cue: Lean forward slightly for chest. Only go as deep as your shoulders are comfortable.

e23.name: Dumbbell Step-up
e23.cue: Knee-height box. Drive through the front heel and don't push off the back foot.

e24.name: Seated Leg Curl
e24.cue: Lean your torso forward a little for a bigger stretch.

e25.name: Seated Calf Raise
e25.cue: 2 s pause at the bottom, 1 s squeeze at the top.

e26.name: EZ-Bar Curl
e26.cue: Elbows still, no hip swing, 2-3 s on the way down.

e27.name: Overhead Cable Triceps Extension
e27.cue: Deep stretch behind the head. This trains the long head, the biggest part of the arm.

e28.name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise
e28.cue: Lean forward slightly, pinkies level with thumbs, slow and controlled.

e29.name: Reverse Crunch
e29.cue: Curl the hips off the bench toward your chest, lower slowly.

e30.name: Side Plank
e30.cue: Straight line from ear to hip to ankle, hips high.

e31.name: Incline Barbell Press (30°)
e31.cue: Bar to the upper chest, elbows slightly tucked.

e32.name: Neutral-Grip Lat Pulldown
e32.cue: Close neutral handle, pull to the upper chest, lean back slightly.

e33.name: Straight-Bar Triceps Pushdown
e33.cue: Elbows pinned, full lockout, slow return.

e34.name: Hanging Leg Raise (straight legs)
e34.cue: Legs straight, raise to hip height or higher, no swinging.

e35.name: Weighted Cable Crunch
e35.cue: Go heavier than in Q1: 8-10 hard reps, round the spine fully.

e36.name: Dumbbell Reverse Lunge
e36.cue: Step back, keep the front shin close to vertical. Easier on the knees than forward lunges.

e37.name: Chest-Supported Row (T-bar or dumbbell)
e37.cue: Chest on the pad, squeeze the shoulder blades. No load on the lower back.

e38.name: Reverse Pec Deck
e38.cue: Arms long, sweep wide, squeeze the rear delts.

e39.name: Hammer Curl
e39.cue: Neutral grip trains the brachialis for thicker arms.

e40.name: Ab Wheel Rollout (kneeling, full range)
e40.cue: Full extension, ribs down, glutes tight, no sagging.

e41.name: Suitcase Carry
e41.cue: Heavy dumbbell in one hand, walk tall and don't lean.

e42.name: Weighted Pull-up
e42.cue: Load with a dip belt. The % covers bodyweight + added weight (see the pull-up formula in the README).

e43.name: Weighted Dips
e43.cue: Lean forward slightly to work the chest. Only go as deep as your shoulders are comfortable.

e44.name: 45° Back Extension
e44.cue: Round slightly over the pad and squeeze the glutes to rise. Hold a plate once 3×12 is easy.

e45.name: EZ-Bar Skull Crusher
e45.cue: Lower the bar behind your head, elbows pointing at the ceiling.

e46.name: Incline Reverse Crunch
e46.cue: Head at the top of an incline bench, curl the hips up and over.

e47.name: Weighted Side Plank
e47.cue: Plate on the top hip, body in one straight line.

e48.name: Incline Dumbbell Press (30°)
e48.cue: Upper-chest priority. Deep stretch, 3 s on the way down.

e49.name: Wide-Grip Lat Pulldown
e49.cue: Width builder. Pull the elbows down and out, squeeze the lats at the bottom.

e50.name: Cable Y-Raise
e50.cue: Cable low, sweep the arm up in a Y in front of the body. Targets the side delts.

e51.name: Overhead Rope Triceps Extension
e51.cue: Face away from the stack, deep stretch.

e52.name: Toes-to-Bar (or Hanging Leg Raise)
e52.cue: Controlled. Use the lats to stay still and curl the pelvis up.

e53.name: Weighted Decline Crunch
e53.cue: Plate on your chest, crunch, don't sit all the way up.

e54.name: Dumbbell Walking Lunge
e54.cue: Long stride, 2 s on the way down, drive through the front heel.

e55.name: Straight-Arm Cable Pulldown
e55.cue: Arms nearly straight, sweep the bar down to your thighs. Isolates the lats for width.

e56.name: Rear-Delt Cable Fly
e56.cue: Cross the cables, sweep the arms wide at shoulder height.

e57.name: Bayesian Cable Curl
e57.cue: Face away from a low cable with the arm behind the body for a full stretch.

e58.name: Ab Wheel Rollout (from feet, shortened range)
e58.cue: Roll toward a wall or up an incline to limit the range. Not ready? Kneeling with a 3 s pause.

e59.name: Cable Woodchopper (high to low)
e59.cue: Rotate through the trunk, arms stay long.

e60.name: Low-to-High Cable Fly
e60.cue: Cables low, sweep the hands up to chin height. Targets the upper chest.

e61.name: High-Box Dumbbell Step-up
e61.cue: Box a bit above knee height for more glute. Control the way down.

e62.name: Preacher Curl
e62.cue: Full stretch at the bottom, don't let the elbows lift.

e63.name: Single-Arm Cable Pushdown
e63.cue: Reverse or neutral grip, full lockout.

e64.name: Lean-Away Cable Lateral Raise
e64.cue: Hold the post and lean away. Keeps tension on the delt at the bottom.

e65.name: Dragon Flag Negative
e65.cue: Grip the bench behind your head, body rigid, lower over 5 s.

e66.name: Hollow Body Hold
e66.cue: Lower back pressed into the floor, arms and legs long.

e67.name: Low-Incline Barbell Press (15-30°)
e67.cue: Bar to the upper chest, 1 s pause on the chest.

e68.name: Weighted Hanging Leg Raise
e68.cue: Light dumbbell between the feet, no swinging.

e69.name: Heavy Cable Crunch
e69.cue: Heavy and strict, full spinal flexion.

e70.name: Deficit Dumbbell Reverse Lunge
e70.cue: Front foot on a 5-10 cm plate for a deeper stretch.

e71.name: Machine Chest-Supported Row
e71.cue: Full stretch forward, squeeze at the back.

e72.name: Ab Wheel Rollout (from feet)
e72.cue: Full range from the feet if you've earned it. Otherwise kneeling with a 3 s pause.

e73.name: Half-Kneeling Pallof Press + Overhead Reach
e73.cue: Press out, raise the arms overhead, return. Don't let the cable rotate you.

e74.name: Dragon Flag
e74.cue: Full rep: lower under control, raise back up as one rigid piece.

e75.name: L-Sit Hold (dip bars or parallettes)
e75.cue: Shoulders pushed down, legs straight (tuck if needed).
